title_zh: 读美的季度报告：净利润之外，再看一遍扣非
title_en: Reading Midea: look beyond headline net profit
summary_zh: 用一份历史季度报告，练习区分主营经营、非经常性项目与现金表现。
summary_en: Use a historical quarterly filing to distinguish operating performance, non-recurring items and cash generation.
source_title: 美的集团股份有限公司 2026 年第一季度报告
source_author: 美的集团 / Midea Group · 巨潮资讯网
body_zh:
## 为什么选这份资料

报告同时列出归母净利润、扣除非经常性损益后的利润及经营现金流，并解释若干财务项目变化，适合做财务阅读练习。

## 怎样读

先核对三个指标，再读非经常性损益明细。观察利润变化有多少来自持续经营，有多少来自资产处置、公允价值变化等项目；接着查看收入增长与业务结构。

## 还缺什么

季度报告未经审计，单季也可能受季节性影响。这是一份历史资料推荐，不是最新业绩更新。形成判断前，还需要后续报告和同口径比较。
body_en:
## Why read it

The filing presents attributable net profit, profit excluding non-recurring items and operating cash flow, alongside explanations of financial movements. It is a useful financial-reading exercise.

## How to read it

Reconcile those three measures before examining the non-recurring schedule. Separate operating performance from items such as asset disposals and fair-value changes, then look at revenue growth and business mix.

## What is still missing

The quarterly report is unaudited and a single quarter may be seasonal. This is a historical reading recommendation, not a current earnings update. Later filings and consistent comparisons are needed before drawing a conclusion.
